title: Ethical considerations for AI-metaverse integration: industry voice
context: The system is an AI-integrated metaverse platform with eCommerce: an immersive 3D virtual world (web and native mobile apps) where users shop, interact through avatars, and use AI-aided features such as recommendations, content moderation, monitoring and customer service. Each design decision is an ethical architectural design decision for integrating AI into this metaverse.
notes: Industry voice. Source of truth: the QOC model ADD4Ethics.py (codeable_models) behind the manuscript 'From Practitioner to Industry Voice: LLM-RAG Assisted Ground Truth Theory for Ethical ADD in AI-Metaverse Integration' (SHA-256 of ADD4Ethics.py: 82a99c0cf81afa4416b97815fe83cd89eb82f6b389328f45efe03db0d8c64481). Questions = decision classes (the three grouping decisions are left out), options = design_solution classes linked to each question (full text; options linked to several questions appear under each), drivers = force links of each option with their effect (++, +, N). 'paper_label' is the short label used in the manuscript's tables, where one exists. Questions without options in the model are classified at question level. Category numbers follow the manuscript (the model's Category 8 is C7 here).
